notes.title: Science and achievements overhaul
notes.content:
Hey everyone,

We tried to fit as much as possible in this update. From playing with friends in other regions to a overhaul to the science system, here is a list of everything changed in the update:


We noticed that some people were not able to play with friends so we added region changes
Zombies will target revived survivors again
Shop owners wont get displaced
Several legendary tier weapon buffs
Survivor animation glitches patched
Tutorial fixes
All science houses are selectable
Zombie screams bug fixes
Revive bug fix
Spectate bug fix
Grenade bug fix
Other small bugs fixes


Then there is a major overhaul to science and achievements

We noticed it is a little to hard to get to a high science level now so we have lowered all the things on the science tree. Everything is now easier to get which makes it more viable to use survivors as scientists.

We also noticed that some achievements were taking too long, so we have tweaked those achievements. Skins and hats will be easier to get. Because of this it could be possible that you have some new hats or skins in the locker!


We hope you all enjoy this update!

Jonahsav

notes.title: New map and tutorial
notes.content:
Hey everyone!

The long awaited update is finally here!

The update consists of a tutorial, new map and performance upgrades.

Patchnotes:

 A full new tutorial
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38882905/1f8e31022d3a33617cf621ef06d4e9c9adb3f7eb.png
A lot of people didn't understand some main features of the game so we decided to make a tutorial explaining all the basics.

 Outpost, a new smaller map
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38882905/fb79d16b60e81a8605a026e649164d0c6dd71fcf.png
Outpost is a small map based behind the nuclear power plant.

 Escape button works in the main menu
 Map selection options
 A pop-up for everyone who launches the game for the first time that advises to play the tutorial
 Performance upgrades for all maps
 Medium render distance has a way smaller render distance to boost performance (we highly recommend medium render distance)
 Intro cutscene animation fix
 Radio store now is always open able and opens city management
 Hat menu fixed
 Removed turbo run on last 5% of the zombies on outpost
 Various bug fixes
 You can't get double hit by a single zombie anymore


We hope you have a lot of fun with the new map!

Cheers,

Jonahsav

notes.title: What do all these menu's do?
notes.content:
Hey everyone!

We noticed some questions about the use of all the menu's, When we Beta tested noone brought up the issue of "to much information", this was probably because everyone understood the concept of the game.

After seeing a Video of someone playing BiteVille we saw what was wrong, too much information and all menu's were accessible after round 1 while they only start having a use later in the game.

So in the most recent patch we have tried to fix that.

Patchnotes:

 Escape button now works on every menu
 Menu's are now only accessible when they have a use (more information below)
 Walking backwards speed increased from 1,5 to 3
 Some area's still had issues with zombies getting stuck, this should be fixed
 "Buy" and "show info" buttons were sometimes only clickable on one half of the button, also fixed!
 Build inventory visual bug
 Added support for a wider range of screen aspect ratio's



Further explanation on all the menu's
Also i would like to explain a few aspects of the game, i understand that thats not the way to go and that everything should be clear, we will work on improving that. But as of right now it hurts to see that people don't understand the main features and quit the game after not understanding.


 The research tree goes automatic, its just a progress bar that you can keep track of to see when you research new cool things.
 You can buy the weapons and builds researched in the research tree at the weapon and build store at the main square. Once you have bought a build (available after 3) you can press "B" this will bring out your build tool, you can also see all the builds you have bought when pressing "I". Remember that you can only build in between rounds.
 After round 5 the radio woman and medic appear, the radio woman will send signal to survivors. At round 6 the first survivor will approach the city (this is indicated by a question mark above the head of the radio women). Talk to her to see the 2 skills of the survivor, Combat and intelligence, you can then assign the survivor to one of two roles, researcher (every intelligence point = 1 research point each round, if they survive the round) or a defender (the higher the combat the more dmg they deal). 
 When you have assigned a survivor to a role the city management map will show up, here you can decide in what building the scientist will work (so they are easier to defend) or where your defender will defend (to create places for your defenders to defend you need to place watchpoints around the map that can be bought at the buildstore)
 If a survivor dies, he or she can be bought back to life at the medic in between rounds!
 One last thing, you can only buy ammo at the ammo boxes for guns that you have already researched, so keep track of your ammo if you are playing with a rare un-researched gun that you got from the mystery box!


Everything should be easier to understand now that all these different menu's only work when they can be used and i hope that this explanation helps with further understanding all the features of the game :)

Thanks for all the positive and negative feedback stay safe and have a good time building up your city!

Cheers,

Jonahsav

notes.title: successful launch!
notes.content:
Whoohooo!

Hey everyone,

I'm proud to say that BiteVille has successfully launched! Thanks to everyone with positive (and negative) feedback, and especially thanks to the people who contributed to the beta.


How did the launch go?
We went live at around 23:00 o'clock and noticed that there were a few unexpected bug:

 Escape menu did not work as intended
 Zombies got stuck in a walk animation at the south side of the map
 Visual bug that made a few UI elements unclear
 The first cutscene had a scene where the characters didn't move
 aaaand last but not least the zombies moved a bit to quick, hehe oops..


We went to bed at around 06:00 but all those things should be fixed now!

we also noticed we underestimated the minimum requirements of the game and we are sorry for anyone who is affected by this. We changed them accordingly.


Whats next?
All the main features off the game are in but we will certainly tweak some things. Next to that we will work on optimalizations and a few more quality of life changes, think of:

 A few extra voicelines for AI's
 Voicelines for drops
 A map u can use in the zombie round
 Location names so calling out stuff is easier
 Special zombie health will change based on the number of players


Suggestions and feedback would help us out a lot, you can use discord to reach out to us and other BiteVille players.


We are really excited, can't thank you guys enough and have fun playing!

Cheers, Jonahsav


P.S.: let me know ur high score in discord i'm curious
